name: Shared TeX Preamble
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Reload the macro file to apply a changed definition.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Shared TeX Preamble is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your math notes.
